name: GST / Sales Tax Calculator
summary: Add or extract GST / sales tax from an amount — exclusive and inclusive modes, locally.
description: Enter an amount and tax rate to see net, tax, and gross totals. Switch between exclusive (add tax) and inclusive (extract tax) modes. Includes Indian GST slab presets (5%, 12%, 18%, 28%) and works for any sales-tax percentage.

faqs.question: What is exclusive vs inclusive tax?
faqs.answer: Exclusive means your amount is before tax and tax is added on top. Inclusive means the amount already includes tax, and the calculator backs out the net and tax portions.

faqs.question: Are the GST presets only for India?
faqs.answer: The 5 / 12 / 18 / 28% buttons match common Indian GST slabs for convenience. You can type any rate for other sales-tax systems.

faqs.question: Is this tax advice?
faqs.answer: No. It is an educational math tool. Confirm filings with a tax professional or official tables.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
